comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Produced via Mycenaean Soldier's Foot Armour and confers Age effect (Mythical Era) EX Effect. Requires Alchemy R7 and Handicrafts R7; I cannot confirm the remaining ingredients at the time of this posting but I figure it calls for the usual set of items listed in Special Purchase Bond comment section -- please correct me if I'm wrong on that. Cheers.
